feature.title: Review packet quality
feature.description: Ensure review agents receive bounded, reviewable context.
acceptanceCriteria: Review packet contains RFC, diff, evidence, history, rules, and artifact digest context.

rfc.summary: Review packet must carry enough context for read-only review.
rfc.background: A review agent cannot audit a feature from only a title.
rfc.featureDescription: Build a deterministic review packet quality gate.
rfc.expectedOutcome: Packet exposes requirements, diff, evidence, history, project rules, and artifacts.
nonGoals: Do not run a live model in this eval.

requirements.statement: The review packet includes reviewable implementation context.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Packet includes RFC, diff, evidence, history, rules, and artifact digests.
